_note: Arrears of rent received from a tenant, or unrealised rent realised subsequently, are income from house property in the year received, whether or not the assessee still owns the property, less thirty per cent (D-155; rulebook HP-ARREARS-001). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.23(1)–(3) — "(3) A sum equal to 30% of the arrears of rent or the unrealised rent referred to in sub-section (1) shall be allowed as deduction" (Gazette 265620, p.48). TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.25A(1)–(2) "a sum equal to thirty per cent. of the arrears of rent or the unrealised rent" (thc p.148; subs. by Act 28 of 2016, s.11, w.e.f. 1-4-2017). The row is the deduction; HousePropertyNode adds the arrears less it. Every regime.
